organizations.nameVariants: Sirius-Verlag; Sirius Verlag Franz Sobotka; Sirius-Verlag F. Sobotka
organizations.publicNote: Music publisher owned by Franz Sobotka. Historical imprints use the forms Sirius Verlag Franz Sobotka and Sirius-Verlag F. Sobotka; the house issued the Sirius-Mappen and the successor periodical Tonfilm Theater Tanz. No matching formal GND or VIAF corporate authority has been identified.

sources.fullCitation: Sirius-Verlag Franz Sobotka. Sirius-Mappen (36 Hefte). Wien–Berlin, 1927–January 1933. Six annual series. Digitised set with an indexed list of 278 titles, Internet Archive.
sources.title: Sirius-Mappen (36 Hefte)
sources.creator: Sirius-Verlag Franz Sobotka
sources.researchNote: The indexed contents name eight Kaper titles, each with its series and issue number: “Auf Wiederseh’n, Herr Doktor! Auf Wiederseh’n, Frau Doktor!” (4-05), “Sagen kleine Mädels ‘nein’” (5-07), “Mondnacht in Sanssouci” (6-02), “Heut’ bin ich gut aufgelegt!”, “Ich weiß ein kleines Café” and “Es wird schon wieder besser” (all 6-09), “Wer weint heut’ aus Liebe Tränen” (6-10) and “Tränen in der Geige” (7-01). All eight use lyrics by Fritz Rotter. The number 7-01 falls outside the six annual Sirius-Mappen series and requires separate interpretation. Contemporary Sirius imprints are catalogued by the Austrian National Library under Sirius Verlag Franz Sobotka.

sources.shortCitation: Tonfilm Theater Tanz (89 Hefte), 1933–1943 — indexed contents
sources.fullCitation: Tonfilm Theater Tanz. Wien, 1933–1943. Monthly, 89 issues, each carrying the music of eight or nine film and operetta numbers. Digitised set with an indexed list of contents, Internet Archive.
sources.title: Tonfilm Theater Tanz (89 Hefte), indexed contents
sources.researchNote: The index names four Kaper numbers with their year and issue: “Wenn ich ’mal eine Dummheit mach’” (33-04), “Immer, wenn ich glücklich bin, muß ich schrecklich weinen” (33-10), “In 24 Stunden kann soviel gescheh’n” (33-11) and “Heut’ ist Karneval” (35-08), the last already cited from the issue itself. The index gives the composers of “Immer, wenn ich glücklich bin” and “In 24 Stunden kann soviel gescheh’n” as Jurmann and Kaper. Hofmeister registers the same two, in April 1933, under the composer name Ernst Martin. The index records contents, not the credit printed on the music: the three 1933 issues have not been examined.
